metadata.description: Aurelia by Dhahaby: gold prices, borrowing estimates against gold, and your own Dhahaby gold account (read-only) for AI agents. Runs on the Aurelia MCP server (https://mcp.dhahaby.com/mcp).

plugins.name: aurelia
plugins.description: Connects the Aurelia MCP server and adds skills for today's gold price, what you could borrow against gold (loan vs card), partner jewellers for certified appraisal, and (after sign-in) your gold pieces and application status.
